back: The book of prime entry for transactions that do not fit any other book (also called the journal proper).
A short explanation written under a journal entry.
Debit each asset; credit each liability and capital. Capital = assets − liabilities.
Debit the asset account; credit the supplier.
Debit irrecoverable debts; credit the customer.
Debit drawings; credit purchases, at cost.

front: Asset brought in by the owner
back: Debit the asset account; credit capital.

front: How do you interpret a journal entry?
back: Read it as a sentence: which account gained value (debit), which gave it (credit), and why (narrative).

front: Terms for a debt that will never be paid
back: ZIMSEC: bad debt. Cambridge: irrecoverable debt.
